corpus: mixed human/model final documents from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Both interval methods exclude the useful margin against base, pooled, donor and uniform; all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods, while useful residual uniform advantage is excluded under both; every residual interval includes zero. Raw sums exclude useful base advantage under both methods and retain useful pooled and donor uncertainty under both, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Mixed human/model training prose, sparse histories, overlapping or expanded human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, seed, rank or corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
